title: Project demo spec
description: public/demos/<slug>/spec.json. scripts/check_schema.mjs enforces the keywords used here; each shot's params are checked against its template's own params schema (references/shot-types.md).

$schema.description: Optional editor hint, e.g. a relative path to this file.

title.description: Project name; the title shot's default heading.

tagline.description: One sentence; the title shot's default tagline.

stack.description: Tech tags shown by the title shot.

aspect.description: Stage shape; 9:16 is the vertical variant.

seed.description: Seed for kit.rand, the only randomness a template may use.

poster_ms.description: Frame used for poster.jpg; render.mjs defaults to the metrics shot's start, else 1000.

duration_ms.description: How long the shot holds the stage; at least the template's min_ms.

caption.description: Real text shown under the stage.
